typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblSLACPemailAddressnewUpdates_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		contraparty as string,
		newAddress as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> EmailUpdates
EmailUpdates sink(input(
		contraparty as string,
		newAddress as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		contraparty,
		newAddress),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblSLACPemailAddressnewUpdates_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblSLACPemailAddressnewUpdates
